title: मध्यमपर्व ३ · अध्याय ९

items.text:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वटस्थानमथो वक्ष्ये तस्य मूले तु दक्षिणे ॥
त्रिहस्तवेदिमुपरि स्थापयेत्कलशत्रयम् ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
|| sūta uvāca || ||
vaṭasthānamatho vakṣye tasya mūle tu dakṣiṇe ||
trihastavedimupari sthāpayetkalaśatrayam || 1 ||

items.text:
गणेशं च शिवं विष्णुं पूजयित्वा हुनेच्चरुम् ॥
रक्तसूत्रैस्त्रिगुणितैः स्वर्णमेव पुरःसरम् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
gaṇeśaṃ ca śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayitvā huneccarum ||
raktasūtraistriguṇitaiḥ svarṇameva puraḥsaram || 2 ||

items.h: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे मध्यमपर्वणि तृतीयभागे नवमोऽध्यायः ।। ९ ।।

en_summary: Suta, speaking to the Brahmins, gives a very short rule for dedicating a banyan tree. At its foot, on the south side, a three-hand altar is made with three pots, and Ganesha, Shiva and Vishnu are worshipped. A rice-and-milk offering is cooked, red threads and gold are used, a barley-and-milk food-offering is given, and the tree is formally given away with spoken words. The post is planted and bound with banyan roots, and the chapter ends in a list of yakshas, nagas, gandharvas, siddhas and wind-gods, apparently those to be honoured. The text is cut short.
